targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type = 'scenario.completed' AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours';
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type = 'scenario.completed' AND received_at > now() - interval '7 days';
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type = 'scenario.completed' AND received_at > now() - interval '30 days';

SELECT count(DISTINCT payload->'scenario'->>'user_email') AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type = 'scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'user_email' IS NOT NULL AND received_at > now() - interval '7 days';

panels.title: Δ день vs вчера
panels.description: Прирост % vs предыдущего эквивалентного периода. ∞ означает что в предыдущем периоде у этого сервиса ещё не было событий — например, AMA_avia_project начал слать телеметрию с 18.05, поэтому неделя/месяц vs ранее показывают ∞. Через 1-2 полных периода значения станут реальными процентами.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (cur - prev) / NULLIF(prev, 0), 1) AS value FROM (   SELECT     count(*) FILTER (WHERE received_at > now() - interval '24 hours') AS cur,     count(*) FILTER (WHERE received_at <= now() - interval '24 hours'       AND received_at > now() - interval '48 hours') AS prev   FROM events   WHERE service IN ($service) AND type = 'scenario.completed' ) t;

panels.title: Конверсия (выдан ≥1 билет)
panels.description: % поисков, где юзеру показали хотя бы один билет: tickets_shown > 0.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int > 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(count(*),0))::numeric(5,1) AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT avg((payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int)::numeric(10,1) AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT (percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total')::int) / 1000.0)::numeric(10,1) AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='llm.inference.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at);
SELECT $__timeGroup(received_at, '5m') AS time, type AS metric, count(*)::float AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;
SELECT type, count(*)::int AS events FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15;
SELECT service AS "Service", type AS "Type", status AS "Status", count(*) AS "Count" FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT received_at AS "Время", service AS "Service", type AS "Type", status AS "Status", data AS "Data" FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT received_at AS "Время", service AS "Service", payload->'scenario'->>'user_email' AS "Email", CASE WHEN type = 'scenario.failed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_type' = 'IndexError' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_message' = 'list index out of range' THEN 'Resolved (PR #381)' WHEN type = 'scenario.failed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_type' = 'AttributeError' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_message' LIKE '%xterms%' THEN 'Resolved (PR #381)' WHEN type = 'scenario.failed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_type' = 'KeyError' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_message' = '''[nan] not in index''' THEN 'Resolved (PR #381)' WHEN type = 'scenario.failed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_type' = 'KeyError' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_message' ~ '^''[A-Z]{3}''$' THEN 'Resolved (PR #383+#397)' WHEN type = 'scenario.failed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_type' = 'KeyError' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_message' ~ '[А-ЯЁ]' THEN 'Resolved (PR #392)' WHEN type = 'scenario.failed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_type' = 'NothingFoundTravelPayouts' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_message' ~ 'unknown locations: [A-Z]{3}' THEN 'Resolved (PR #383)' WHEN type = 'scenario.failed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_type' = 'NothingFoundTravelPayouts' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_message' LIKE '%invalid-adult-passengers%' THEN 'Resolved (PR #384)' WHEN type = 'scenario.failed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_type' = 'NothingFoundTravelPayouts' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_message' LIKE '%invalid-destination%' THEN 'Resolved (PR #385)' WHEN type = 'http.request.sent' AND payload->'response'->>'status_code' = '400' THEN 'Resolved (PR #385)' WHEN type = 'scenario.failed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_type' = 'NothingFoundTravelPayouts' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_message' LIKE '%invalid-date%' THEN 'Unresolved (LLM год даты)' WHEN type = 'scenario.failed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_type' = 'TypeError' THEN 'Unresolved (TypeError)' WHEN type = 'scenario.failed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_type' = 'KeyError' THEN 'Unresolved (KeyError other)' WHEN type = 'scenario.failed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_type' = 'NothingFoundTravelPayouts' THEN 'Not a bug (no tickets)' WHEN type = 'http.request.sent' AND payload->'response'->>'status_code' IN ('429', '503') THEN 'External API issue' WHEN type = 'http.request.sent' AND payload->'response'->>'status_code' IS NULL THEN 'Unresolved (HTTP timeout)' WHEN type = 'http.request.sent' AND payload->'response'->>'status_code' = '200' THEN 'Unresolved (HTTP 200 marked failed)' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "Статус", type AS "Тип события", CASE WHEN type = 'scenario.failed' THEN payload->'scenario'->>'error_type'      WHEN type = 'http.request.sent' THEN COALESCE(payload->'response'->>'status_code', 'no-response')      ELSE '-' END AS "Error / Code", CASE WHEN type = 'scenario.failed' THEN LEFT(COALESCE(payload->'scenario'->>'error_message', ''), 200)      WHEN type = 'http.request.sent' THEN LEFT(COALESCE(payload->'response'->>'error', payload->'request'->>'url', ''), 200)      ELSE '' END AS "Сообщение / URL", LEFT(COALESCE(data, ''), 200) AS "User query" FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND status = 'failed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 500;

panels.title: Последние поиски (scenario.completed)
panels.description: Только для проектов, шлющих type='scenario.completed' с payload.scenario (avia-style schema).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.received_at AS "Время", e.service AS "Service", e.payload->'scenario'->>'user_email' AS "Email", e.data AS "Запрос", (e.payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int AS "Билетов", ((e.payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total')::int / 1000.0)::numeric(10,1) AS "Sec", e.status AS "Статус", COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(CASE w.data WHEN 'compliance.violation' THEN 'Compliance: запрос не прошёл проверку' WHEN 'compliance.country_substituted' THEN 'Страна заменена на столицу/хаб' WHEN 'compliance.country_unknown' THEN 'Неизвестная страна (резолв не сработал)' WHEN 'compliance.adults_too_many' THEN 'Слишком много взрослых (лимит 9)' WHEN 'compliance.date_beyond_horizon' THEN 'Дата за горизонтом +365 дней' WHEN 'compliance.departure_date_missing' THEN 'Дата вылета не указана' WHEN 'compliance.complex_segment_missing' THEN 'Сложный маршрут: сегмент не распознан' WHEN 'compliance.complex_segment_dates_inferred' THEN 'Сложный маршрут: даты подставлены автоматически' WHEN 'compliance.complex_segment_origins_inferred' THEN 'Сложный маршрут: phantom-сегмент удалён' WHEN 'compliance.travelpayouts_unknown_location' THEN 'TravelPayouts не принимает IATA-код' WHEN 'search.no_direct_flights' THEN 'Прямых рейсов нет — расширили на соседние даты' WHEN 'search.no_direct_neighboring' THEN 'Прямых нет даже на соседних — показаны с пересадками' WHEN 'search.time_interval_expanded_to' THEN 'Расширили окно времени вылета (туда)' WHEN 'search.time_interval_expanded_back' THEN 'Расширили окно времени вылета (обратно)' WHEN 'search.filter_not_applied' THEN 'Фильтр не применён (нет результатов)' WHEN 'search.partial_dates' THEN 'Часть запрошенных дат — без рейсов' ELSE w.data END, E'
' ORDER BY w.received_at) FROM events w WHERE w.type = 'system.warning.shown' AND w.request_id = e.request_id), '') AS "Системные предупреждения" FROM events e WHERE e.service IN ($service) AND e.type = 'scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(e.received_at) ORDER BY e.received_at DESC LIMIT 100;
